summary: FROST's long Lenis-scrolled specimen for FT Scenik, a 142-style geometric sans inspired by Margate (wdth, wght, slnt, a 'scenders' set): a Lottie wordmark, a burger drawer with progress, per-row editable testers with tracking/leading/colour/style-set controls, archival Margate photos, axes explained by cartoon characters, and a fixed black 'Trial | Buy' pill. The desktop capture froze on the loader (smooth-scroll container), so the content was read from the HTML, the video and the mobile capture.

instances.look: Off-white page; after a loader the black wordmark 'SCENIK' fills the full width at the bottom of the first screen, its letters in different weights and widths (light geometric S C E, then blocky black N I K); below a ruled line, a four-line intro paragraph ('FT Scenik is a typeface inspired by the modernist typography of Margate…') with 'FROST' underlined
instances.ux: Loader: 'FROST presents Scenik' and 'Influenced by Margate' in tiny type; 'F ROS T' collapses to 'FT' and becomes the nav title; the wordmark draws itself in (Lottie); the whole header links to the shop; a green dot cursor follows the pointer
instances.learn: Let the loader's credit line shrink into the nav title ('FROST presents' → 'FT'): the intro and the persistent header become one continuous piece of typography

reconstruction.layout: First screen 100vh: tiny title row at y≈372 during loading; wordmark 1920×459 Lottie scaled to the container width (~1380px wide, ~330px tall) anchored to the bottom of the viewport with ~30px margins; then a hairline rule and the paragraph full width (~1380px)
reconstruction.typography: Wordmark: FT Scenik mixed (Thin Regular width to Super Condensed), caps; intro ~30px FT Scenik Text Medium, leading ~1.15; loader/nav 14px FT Scenik Text Regular (wdth 500, wght 350)
reconstruction.behaviour: ~4.5s intro: .title_ros width animates to 0 (CSS var --ROS 27.6px) and 'presents' fades (--pres), background .site_intro_background fades; Lottie SVG animation of the wordmark plays once; Lenis smooth scroll; custom .cursor 20px #b6f6b1 circle that grows with a label on hover
reconstruction.content: Real intro copy about Margate's modernist typography
reconstruction.assets: Lottie JSON of the wordmark animation
reconstruction.html: section#foreword > a.foreword_header_container > div.foreword_header > div.foreword_header_motion > div.lottie-animation-container > svg

instances.look: Fixed slim header with a hairline rule: 'FT Scenik' left (born from the loader's 'FROST presents Scenik'), the current chapter name centred ('Influenced by Margate', 'Family', 'Styles', 'Variables'…) and the burger icon right; the bottom of each mobile screen repeats 'FT Scenik · <chapter>'

Not cut as a block: a small black pill 'Trial | Buy' fixed at the bottom centre of every screen, with 'Exclusively at FROST'; at the end, a pre-footer with the FROST mascot and 'STUDENTS GET 75% OFF — Use the code STUDENTXYZ to get 75% off your purchase at frostype.xyz'
instances.ux: The pill links to the FROST collection page from anywhere; the student code is a plain incentive

instances.look: 'Styles' chapter: eight editable specimens from display to mono, each labelled with its style ('FT Scenik Condensed Super' → 'SCOOP' fitted to the full width; 'Condensed Heavy' → 'NEW AT TURNER CONTEMPORARY'; 'Medium' → 'Dreamland ® A one stop ↘ of local culture…'; Text Bold, Regular, Medium paragraphs about Margate's Old Town; 'Mono Light' paragraph), each with a tool row
instances.ux: Per row: Tracking and Leading sliders, a colour picker (#000000), style-set toggles (Alt a, Internal Dots, Square Dots, Scenders) and Reset; display lines are contenteditable and auto-fit to the width
instances.learn: Give every row its own typographic controls (tracking, leading, colour, sets) with tuned defaults per size: big rows start tight, text rows loose

reconstruction.layout: Full-width rows on a 12-col grid; tool row above each specimen (label left, ranges and toggles inline, Reset right); display lines nowrap and scaled to the container (333px, 198px, 118px); text rows in 2 columns

reconstruction.content: Margate copy: 'SCOOP', 'NEW AT TURNER CONTEMPORARY', 'Dreamland ® A one stop ↘ of local culture, food, festivals & vintage rides', Old Town and Turner Contemporary paragraphs
reconstruction.html: section#styles > div.styles[style=--track1…--lead8] > div.style_N.style > div.style_specimen_tools (input[type=range] ×2, input[type=color], p.style_specimen_tools_set ×4, p.reset) + div.style_specimen > p#style_N[contenteditable]
